subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `openclaw agent --message-file` remain compatible with readable non-regular paths, or intentionally become restricted to regular files and symlinks resolving to regular files?
rationale: The shipped implementation accepts readable sources through `fs.readFile`, while this PR introduces a regular-file-only boundary; source and documentation do not establish that compatibility break as intentional product policy.

options.title: Preserve readable sources
options.body: Use a bounded streaming read that retains previously readable source types while rejecting input after 4 MiB.

options.title: Restrict to regular files
options.body: Accept the compatibility change, then document it and add focused upgrade-oriented rejection tests.

recommendation.title: Preserve readable sources
recommendation.body: Use a bounded streaming read that retains previously readable source types while rejecting input after 4 MiB.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original feature and are the strongest available current-history routing candidate for its CLI compatibility contract.
